The two-timescale law is therefore the best-supported candidate and should be fit numerically, then checked against fresh confirmation.

The large-H negative response and positive short-H responses point to horizon-dependent adaptation, not a static branch ambiguity.
It is explicitly high variance and does not help identify this horizon-dependent law.
